chunks: And in another hadith: "He may delay it until the night."

key_terms.اللَّيْلِ: the night, indicating the permitted time limit
key_terms.حَدِيثٍ: a hadith or narration cited as supporting evidence
key_terms.يُؤَخِّرُهُ: he delays it or postpones it

ai.seo_question: Can it be delayed until the night in this hajj ruling?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the act in question may be postponed until the night. In the chapter context, it indicates a legal allowance related to the timing of the rite being discussed.
